description.value: Silvertip Lodge is an exclusive, off-grid heli-skiing lodge set on a 14-acre lakefront property at the remote eastern end of Quesnel Lake in BC's Cariboo Mountains, reachable only by a 45-minute helicopter flight from Williams Lake. The 7,250 sq. ft. triple A-frame lodge accommodates a small number of guests in eight en-suite rooms plus a separate lakefront cabin, with world-class dining, a spa chalet featuring sauna, steam room, and outdoor hot tub, and guided access to a 1,440 sq. km. ski tenure. It operates completely off-grid with satellite Wi-Fi throughout.

address.value: East Arm Quesnel Lake, Cariboo F, BC V0L 1L0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Silvertip Lodge is a real, actively operating luxury heli-skiing lodge on Quesnel Lake in BC's Cariboo Mountains, with 2027 booking policies posted and a full team listed. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed in the FAQ ('Wi-Fi is available throughout the lodge'). No cycling-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site, and the lodge is accessible only by helicopter from Williams Lake, making it effectively unreachable by touring cyclists on bikes.
concerns: Lodge is accessible only by helicopter (45-minute flight from Williams Lake); it is not reachable by road or by bike, severely limiting its utility for touring cyclists.
No street address provided in OSM or on the website; location is described only as 'far east end of Quesnel Lake'.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business with active bookings and a full staff roster. Included as a legitimate accommodation listing despite being a highly niche, helicopter-access-only property.
enrichment_extras.notes: The lodge is entirely off-grid and set within Crown Land wilderness. Its all-inclusive package covers meals, beverages, and accommodation; the spa and dining facilities are high-end but cyclist-specific amenities are entirely unconfirmed.
